package_assembly_starts.falsifying_evidence: The assembly-start source is a tool-slot or theoretical-throughput measure before interposer or substrate availability, requiring those material pools to remain separate constraints.
package_assembly_starts.methodology: Defines each synthetic package assembly start as a package slot for which the required silicon interposer and ABF substrate have already been issued. package_assembly_starts.notes: Synthetic scope declaration used to expose and prevent potential double counting. Direct interposer and substrate capacity remain evidence gaps.
